Vin II 150, 14 (coḷakaṃ uppannaṃ hoti … anujānāmi bhikkhave ~aṃ kātun ti, Be, Se so; Ce cilimikā; Ee cilimikaṃ); IV 40, 26 (~aṃ vā uttarattharaṇaṃ vā … ajjhokāse santharitvā, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce cilimikaṃ; Sp 775, 34 : ~ā nāma sudhādi-parikammakatāya bhūmiyā vaṇṇānurakkhaṇatthaṃ katā hoti, taṃ heṭṭhā pattharitvā upari kaṭasārakaṃ pattharanti, Be, Se so; Ee ~aṃ nāma; Ce cilimikā nāma); Sp 666, 26 (bhummattharaṇan ti … ~āhi kata-attharaṇaṃ, Be, Ce so; Se vilimikāhi; Ee ~āhi katvā attharanti; Sp-ṭ [ Be ] II 403, 1 : ~āhī ti paṭapilotikāhi); 884, 6 (tūlaṃ onaddhaṃ etthā ti tūlonaddhaṃ, tūlaṃ pakkhipitvā upari ~āya onaddhan ti vuttaṃ hoti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee cilimikāya) ≠ Kkh 2 244, 22 ( Be, Ee so; Ce ciḷimikāya); Sp 1110, 26 (daḷhīkammakaraṇamattenā ti dve ~āyo ekato katvā sibbitamattena, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce cilimikāyo); 1218, 32 (ullokaṃ akaritvā ti heṭṭhā ~aṃ adatvā, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce cilimikaṃ); 1344, 19 (dasa senāsanānī ti mañco … bimbohanaṃ ~ā uttarattharaṇaṃ … tiṇasanthāro paṇṇasanthāro ti, eds so ); Ps II 215, 5 (~ā cammakhaṇḍo tiṇasanthāro paṇṇasanthāro ti idaṃ santhatasenāsanaṃ nāma, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee cilimikā) = Mp III 200, 12 ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee cilimikā); Pv-a 144, 13 (saṅkārakūṭādito paṃsukūlaṃ gahetvā dhovitvā bhisiṃ ca ~aṃ ca katvā bhikkhūnaṃ adāsi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr bhisiñcimillikañ ca); Vin-vn 1070 (bhisi ~ā).
